name: the Local Group
plain: The Milky Way, Andromeda (2.5 million light years away), Triangulum and the two Magellanic Clouds, each a drawing at its measured place, distance and rough size (galactic coordinates from NED, rounded); the tilt of each disc is chosen, not measured. Once they are specks the measured ones wear a thin ring. The galaxies and small groups beyond are scattered by rule, none of them a real one, except that the Virgo cluster is put at its measured direction and distance (54 million light years).

carrier.state: five galaxies, each a drawing at its measured place and rough size, and a field scattered by rule

basis.note: its Milky Way is spiral(0x4d57, 1300) and the rung below draws spiral(0x4d57, 3800): one seed, a sequential generator, so this rung's Milky Way is the first 1300 points of the finer one, at the same metres. That PART is a function of the rung below; the other galaxies and the field are this rung's own, so the rung as a whole is not.

parts.what: each galaxy's direction, distance and rough size; the Virgo cluster's direction and distance

source.external: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), galactic coordinates, rounded

views.reads: the rung's marks at the zoom's metres per pixel

budget.quantity: what drawing a tile coarse may move against drawing it fine: the draw allocator's tolerance (Acuity, eps_px). It is not a bound on the picture's faithfulness to the holon.
